method: Actual evaluated mesh face/edge extraction, doubleprecision interpolation along native horizontal boundary segments. This measures modeled shared plane directly; no expected coordinate substituted. Float BVH rays1e-7 inside a boundary can miss n-gon top; raw such diagnostics retained separately.
interpretation: Guaranteed commonW=.78 is inside actual evaluated terminal boundaryW=.814 and physical treadW=.96. Native cap clear width=.78. Floor contact support extends beyond terminal fullwidth across X[-.48,.48].
